name: Cloudflare R2
tagline: High-speed S3 object store with 10GB free tier and $0 bandwidth fees.

instructions.navBreadcrumb: Cloudflare Dashboard › R2 Object Storage › Manage API Tokens
instructions.step1: Log in to your Cloudflare Dashboard and navigate to the R2 section.
instructions.step2: Click 'Create API Token' and select 'Object Read & Write' permission.
instructions.step3: Copy your Account ID, Access Key ID, and Secret Access Key into Ocloud.

fields.label: S3 Endpoint URL (or Account ID)
fields.helper: Copy your Account ID from the right sidebar of R2, or paste your S3 API URL

fields.label: Bucket Name
fields.helper: The specific R2 bucket to mount into your filesystem

fields.label: Access Key ID
fields.helper: Generated during R2 API Token creation

fields.label: Secret Access Key
fields.helper: Secret value shown only once upon token generation
